races.paceDynamic: Manoir De Mirande is the only proven front-runner and will dictate proceedings from the off, likely to get an uncontested lead in this 17-runner maiden hurdle. With most of the field being hold-up horses and the prominent runners either unproven or lacking pace angle, Manoir De Mirande can bowl along at a comfortable rhythm without early pressure. The large field will string out early with the bulk of runners settling in behind, setting up a scenario where the pace-setter gets first run while the hold-up brigade face a traffic nightmare in the straight. This race shape strongly favours the leader and any horse that can track close early, as the hold-up horses will struggle to find racing room when it matters.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Manoir De Mirande jumps cleanly and gets an easy lead without pressure from Arouet
scenarios.body: The proven front-runner can dictate at his own pace and kick for home with a crucial first run advantage. The large field of hold-up horses will struggle for racing room behind, making it difficult to mount effective challenges.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Pace Pressure
scenarios.trigger: If Arouet or one of the unknown quantities challenges Manoir De Mirande early for the lead
scenarios.body: A genuine pace battle develops that could compromise both leaders, opening the door for strong finishers with the class to capitalize. The honest pace will suit horses that can travel well in behind and find clear runs.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Manoir De Mirande falters late and multiple hold-up horses converge simultaneously in a bunched finish
scenarios.body: The large field creates a cavalry charge with several horses arriving at once, favouring the most experienced or best-handled runners who can find gaps. Jockey strength becomes crucial in navigating the melee.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Shock Newcomer Success
scenarios.trigger: If one of the lightly-raced newcomers shows significantly more ability than their limited form suggests
scenarios.body: A well-schooled debutant or improving type takes advantage of a truly-run race to spring a surprise. The Mullins-trained Maestro Des Pins has the profile to benefit most from this scenario.

watchPoints.text: Manoir De Mirande must jump cleanly early as any mistake will hand the initiative to lesser pace angles and compromise his main tactical weapon
Watch for early positioning of Arouet and Maestro Des Pins as these are the main threats who could either pressure the leader or benefit from honest gallop
Monitor how quickly the field strings out after the first few hurdles as this will determine whether hold-up horses get racing room or face traffic problems
Paul Townend's urgency on Maestro Des Pins in early stages will indicate fitness levels after 162-day absence
Keep an eye on the 7lb claimers' positioning as inexperienced riders could get caught wide or out the back in this large field

races.paceDynamic: Shirzan will take this race along from the front with his confirmed leading style, setting what should be a sustainable gallop over this 2m1½f trip. Le Roi Du Livet and Big Dispute are the likely prominent trackers, but with only one genuine front-runner, Shirzan won't face early pressure. The large contingent of hold-up horses (Thisain'tthat, Moon Mission, Royal Soldier, Blue Train, Crohan Lady) suggests the pace will be honest but not breakneck in the early stages. This setup clearly favours the hold-up merchants who can settle and produce their trademark late kicks when the early pace softens.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Shirzan sets a steady early gallop without serious pressure from the prominent runners
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up brigade gets the perfect tactical setup to unleash their finishing kicks in the final half-mile. Moon Mission, Royal Soldier, and Blue Train are best positioned to capitalize on this likely unfolding.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure Pays
scenarios.trigger: If Le Roi Du Livet or Big Dispute decide to put genuine pressure on Shirzan from an early stage
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and prevents the hold-up horses from getting their ideal race shape. Big Dispute's strong recent form and Le Roi Du Livet's class edge them over the patient types.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Shirzan Wire-To-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runner can dictate fractions completely unchallenged through the early and middle stages
scenarios.body: His uncontested lead allows him to save enough energy for the closing stages despite his modest recent form. The hold-up horses find themselves with too much ground to make up when the real running begins.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses challenge Shirzan simultaneously or the pace becomes stop-start through indecision
scenarios.body: The disrupted rhythm suits the most adaptable performers who can handle tactical complications. Crohan Lady's experience and Moon Mission's recent running give them edges in messy circumstances.

races.paceDynamic: Hillhead Runner and Rebel Queen are confirmed front runners who will contest the early lead, setting up an honest gallop from flag to finish. With both likely to ensure a solid pace throughout, this creates an ideal scenario for hold-up horses to close late. The presence of two genuine pace angles means there's unlikely to be any dawdling, particularly over this extended 2m3f trip. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can settle off the pace and time their challenge late, as the front runners will soften each other up.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the two front runners duel early and maintain honest fractions throughout
scenarios.body: The pace will be strong enough to set up perfectly for closers, with Hillhead Runner and Rebel Queen softening each other up. Hold-up horses with the highest class will have ideal conditions to sweep past tired leaders.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the pace-setters can steal a march and dictate without fierce pressure
scenarios.body: Either Hillhead Runner or Rebel Queen could potentially get loose on the front end and prove hard to peg back over this stamina-sapping trip. The winner would need to show improved stamina and tactical speed.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses early with neither front runner committing fully
scenarios.body: Horses sitting just off the pace like La Cote Fleurie and Ann Bulkley could find themselves perfectly positioned to strike. This would require a more tactical affair than expected from the early exchanges.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the race turns into a complete stamina test with multiple fallers or stopping horses
scenarios.body: One of the lightly-raced newcomers could emerge from the pack if proven form horses disappoint. This would require a truly-run race where class doesn't necessarily triumph.

races.paceDynamic: Lady Bluebird stands alone as the only confirmed front-runner in this 18-runner field, giving her a massive tactical advantage to dictate proceedings unchallenged. With prominent runners like Galavanting George, Jay Pee M, Bop Wont Stop, Swelltime, Somersby Roost, Fairyland Opera and Minority Interest likely to sit just behind her, the early pace should be honest but sustainable. The large field of hold-up horses including Silent Selector, Eastmore, Nothing Hectic, Liceo, Mount Ferns, Bearami Creek, Under Cover, Rubi Tuesday, Brave Crogha and Speakasyoufind will create a wall of traffic in behind. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable scrimmaging in the pack.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Lady Bluebird Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Lady Bluebird gets an easy lead and maintains her jumping rhythm.
scenarios.body: She can dictate a pace that suits her stamina reserves while the large pack behind gets into trouble at the business end. The prominent runners get first crack at her while the hold-up brigade struggle for racing room.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners can track Lady Bluebird closely and pounce when she weakens.
scenarios.body: Galavanting George, Swelltime and Fairyland Opera are well-positioned to capitalize without getting trapped in traffic. Their tactical positioning gives them the jump on the hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses or Lady Bluebird goes too fast early and stops quickly.
scenarios.body: Silent Selector and Eastmore have the class to weave through traffic and finish strongly if gaps appear. Nothing Hectic's recent Mallow win shows he handles the track well.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Lady Bluebird goes too slowly and the field bunches up turning for home.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where the freshest hold-up horses can emerge from the pack. Traffic problems become less significant in a slowly-run race.

races.paceDynamic: Claude is the sole confirmed front runner and will set a sustainable gallop without early pressure from the prominent racers like Moylussa, Coded Welder and Shesakindofmagic who are likely to sit just off the pace. The large field of 18 runners includes multiple hold-up horses including Jaadil, Way Down South and Jisco Du Brem who will need the race to develop into a strong tempo to be effective. With Claude getting an easy lead and the race likely to be run at a steady tempo until the final stages, this setup strongly favours prominent racers who can track the leader and kick clear, while the hold-up horses may struggle if the pace doesn't truly develop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Claude sets steady fractions and prominent racers get ideal position tracking
scenarios.body: The measured pace allows horses like Moylussa, Coded Welder and Shesakindofmagic to travel comfortably in behind before unleashing finishing kicks. Claude's solo lead becomes vulnerable to multiple challengers who've conserved energy perfectly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wire-To-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Claude maintains his lead throughout and the prominent pack fails to mount sustained pressure
scenarios.body: Claude's class advantage at OR 110 tells as he controls the tempo completely and finds enough in the tank to repel late challenges. The hold-up horses are left with too much ground to make up in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens significantly in the middle stages creating a strong tempo
scenarios.body: The increased gallop sets up perfectly for the hold-up horses like Jaadil and Way Down South to unleash their finishing kicks from the back. Claude and the prominent racers feel the effects of the stronger pace and fade in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Claude goes too slowly early and the field bunches up entering the straight
scenarios.body: The lack of pace creates a sprint finish where any horse with a turn of foot can win regardless of early position. This chaotic finish could see an outsider like Maxicourt or Humble Brag steal victory from the pack.

Little John and Doctor Elvis should track them prominently, while the multiple hold-up horses (Seek A Richer Life, Zambezi Moon, Deerpark Hill, Clone Cross, Loyal Praetorian) will be anchored towards the rear. With two pace-setters over 3m½f on good ground, this creates an honest tempo that should play to the strengths of prominent runners and those with tactical speed, rather than pure hold-up merchants who need a collapse.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Benefits Prominent
scenarios.trigger: If Doctor Du Mesnil and Jeroboam Machin maintain a solid tempo throughout
scenarios.body: The even pace allows prominent runners to position perfectly and kick when it matters, while pure hold-up horses struggle to make up ground. Doctor Elvis and Little John can track the leaders and have the class to capitalize when the front pair weaken.

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.trigger: If Doctor Du Mesnil gets an easy lead and times his effort perfectly

scenarios.label: C

scenarios.trigger: If both front runners go too hard early and tie up dramatically
scenarios.body: The strong early gallop sets up a tactical finish where hold-up horses can sweep past tired leaders. Zambezi Moon's recent winning form and Seek A Richer Life's fresh legs could prove decisive in a sprint finish.

scenarios.trigger: If the sustained pace over the extended trip finds out horses lacking fitness
scenarios.body: The demanding conditions favor those with proven stamina credentials and recent race fitness. Deerpark Hill's long absence and Clone Cross's moderate form leave them exposed, while fresher horses struggle with the demands.

races.paceDynamic: Made In The Woods and Toor Moon are the confirmed leaders who will contest the early pace in this 24-runner handicap hurdle. With both front-runners having modest ratings (OR 78 and 77), they're unlikely to set a breakneck gallop, creating a steady but honest tempo over the extended 3m½f trip. The large field means traffic problems are inevitable, particularly approaching hurdles, which will disadvantage those needing late runs from the back. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and patient hold-up horses with proven stamina - those relying on quick finishing kicks from rear positions will struggle in the scramble.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Patient Hold-Up Wins
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays honest and the field remains bunched turning in
scenarios.body: The steady gallop allows hold-up horses to position closer than usual while saving energy for a sustained finish. Stamina becomes the key factor over traffic luck.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strike
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders fades early creating a tactical void
scenarios.body: A prominent runner can slip into an uncontested lead and control the finish from the front. The large field behind gets strung out chasing the new leader.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Made In The Woods or Toor Moon get an easy lead with minimal pressure
scenarios.body: The honest pace becomes pedestrian allowing the leader to kick clear when others are still organising their challenges. Late closers run out of room and time.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Cavalry Charge
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go too fast early trying to assert dominance
scenarios.body: The strong pace sets up a blanket finish where any horse with a clear run can win. Form gets turned upside down in the melee.

watchPoints.text: Made In The Woods and Toor Moon both going forward early - if they go too fast the race becomes lottery
Traffic problems at hurdles inevitable with 24 runners - hold-up horses need clear jumping to be competitive
Only For Our Man and Navy Waves both travelling strongly turning in - they could dominate finish if positioned well
Several horses returning from long breaks including Ranger Billy (311 days) and I See Fog (391 days) - fitness unknown
Multiple runners with fade tendencies including Moonshine Girl, Three County Star, and Head For Home - stamina test will expose them
